technical-summary: Adapted the manifest-to-Radiance option bridge to multiply its admitted per-rank host pool by TP for Radiance 2.1's aggregate --host-pool-mib parser input. Rejects TP zero, signed-MiB overflow, and missing registry projection. The focused manifest bridge patch test compiled and passed, including TP3 arithmetic and overflow/invalid cases.
user-summary-candidate: Preserved the manifest’s per-rank host-memory admission when launching through Radiance 2.1’s aggregate pool option.
